eniktab-scientific-paper-writer-journal-.description: Fetch live submission requirements for any scientific journal before writing. Use before scientific-writing or any manuscript task: retrieves author guidelines, word limits, abstract format, figure limits, citation style, AI authorship policy (exact disclosure language), and LaTeX template via WebSearch/WebFetch. Stores results in journal_profile.yaml as the single source of truth for all formatting decisions. Covers Nature family, Cell Press, Elsevier, Wiley, Springer, PLOS, PNAS, ACS, RSC, IEEE, ACM, and any other journal.

eniktab-scientific-paper-writer-scientif.description: Full-lifecycle scientific paper writing assistant for any journal. Invoke for: drafting/revising manuscripts, structuring arguments, statistical reporting, citation verification, peer-review responses, grant proposals, posters, literature reviews. Dynamically fetches the target journal's submission guidelines, AI authorship policy, word limits, citation format, and LaTeX template via WebSearch/WebFetch before writing. Writes in authentic expert scientific prose — no AI-detectable patterns. Two-stage write: outline→prose. Final output is publication-ready.
eniktab-scientific-paper-writer-scientif.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, Glob, Grep

eniktab-scientific-paper-writer-examples.description: Full-lifecycle scientific paper writing assistant. Fetches live journal guidelines, AI authorship policy, word limits, citation format, and LaTeX template for any journal before writing. Audits every draft for 25 AI writing patterns. Verifies every citation via web search. Produces publication-ready prose for Nature, Science, Cell, PNAS, NeurIPS, and any other venue.
eniktab-scientific-paper-writer-examples.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, Glob, Grep
